summary_1line: The creature reads influential books, learns of his horrific origin from Victor’s journal, and is violently rejected when he finally approaches the De Lacey family.

image_candidates.scene_text: The creature discovers a portmanteau in the forest and opens it by moonlight to reveal three books.
The creature kneels beside the blind old man De Lacey, grasping his hand and pleading for friendship beside the cottage fire.
Felix bursts into the cottage and beats the creature with a stick while Agatha faints and Safie flees in terror.
